title: R4 — HOSTILE PROOF-STATE PORTABILITY
objective: Test whether a verified proof-state package preserves semantic authority, receipt lineage, canonical identity and lifecycle accounting after producer context is destroyed, runtime/backend identity changes, receipts are replayed or corrupted, liabilities accumulate, verification scales, representation switches repeat, and the correct result is sometimes refusal.

canonicalization_profile.rule: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false; R4 package/certificate payloads forbid floating-point numbers so the profile is deterministic across tested runtimes.
canonicalization_profile.not_claimed: This profile is not advertised as full RFC 8785 JCS.

R4_A.name: FRESH_PROCESS_AMNESIA
R4_A.pass: A verifier running in a fresh job/process with no producer cache accepts frozen package/certificate artifacts solely from serialized inputs and immutable repository verifier code.

R4_B.name: CROSS_MACHINE_CANONICAL_REPLAY
R4_B.pass: Independent runners on at least two OS families recompute the same canonical package hash and exact semantics verdict from the same frozen package artifact.

R4_C.name: RECEIPT_NECROMANCER
R4_C.pass: Valid old receipts fail closed when rebound to a mutated package, parent, operation, parameters, successor, capability digest, backend contract or certificate; stale/replayed receipts cannot authorize a successor.

R4_D.name: BACKEND_SHIP_OF_THESEUS
R4_D.pass: A package produced by backend version B_v remains independently replayable after B_v is no longer the active producer, and a B_(v+1) successor may consume authority only through the verified receipt chain rather than by trusting backend name/version.

R4_E.name: LIABILITY_BOMB
R4_E.pass: Individually bounded small liabilities are accumulated explicitly; once the frozen lifecycle budget is exceeded, materialization is blocked and no per-step-small shortcut is accepted.

R4_F.name: VERIFICATION_SCALING
R4_F.pass: Producer and verifier work are measured separately over a frozen scale ladder. If the exact fallback verifier enumerates 2^n assignments by construction, the result is labeled BACKEND_VERIFICATION_COMPLEXITY_BARRIER rather than promoted to a language theorem.

R4_G.name: SWITCH_STORM
R4_G.pass: A frozen repeated ROBDD<->D_DNNF switch trajectory preserves exact semantics and uninterrupted provenance/receipt lineage while charging every producer and verifier step.

R4_H.name: CORRECT_REFUSAL
R4_H.pass: For a frozen capability trajectory with no theorem/receipt-backed cheap route, planner returns NO_CERTIFIED_CHEAP_ROUTE without UNKNOWN promotion, hidden fallback materialization or external-theorem-as-internal-receipt substitution.

scale_ladder.classification_rule: Finite measured data never establishes an asymptotic language theorem; verifier enumeration complexity may be inferred only from the verifier algorithm itself.

correct_refusal_case.reason: Known exact relaxation to DNNF supports EXISTS but loses the certified COUNT capability; no frozen certified route restores COUNT.
